metadata.description: Official AgencyCore plugins for Claude Code and Cowork

plugins.name: ac-cli
plugins.description: AgencyCore CLI skills for CRM, outreach automation (Envoy), workflow management, admin operations, and platform utilities -- companies, people, deals, sequences, drafts, inbox, schedules, user management, usage analytics, and more

plugins.name: agencycore-design
plugins.description: Build UI in any AgencyCore repository against the shipped design system: resolves the repo's declared kit and theme, reads the installed DESIGN.md specs, answers component and icon lookups, and runs the design preflight. The plugin lives in the ac-design-system repository; its version is that repository's .claude-plugin/plugin.json.
